semantics.definition: The base platform laid into a Möbius strip as wide as it, curving all the way round and twisting to come back turned over, every tile square, tiles and astroids on both faces. A trial: nothing is set on it yet.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one Möbius strip every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Try the base platform as a loop with one side only.

measure.length: how long it is all the way round
